$comment: Guardrail policy. Data rather than code, so the people accountable for what the automation may do can read and change it without a deploy.

allowlist.$comment: Only these origins may be touched, checked on navigation AND re-checked after redirects.
allowlist.$comment2: The app's fault-injection control plane is a test affordance and is explicitly off-limits to the agent, so it cannot arm its own failures.

risk.$comment: Irreversible steps escalate to a human in BOTH modes. A capability that opens an account does not get to do so unsupervised just because a human happened to start the run.

redaction.$comment: PII keeps its last 4 characters in logs. A log in which every member ID reads [REDACTED] cannot be used to trace which record a failure happened on, which makes the system unoperable in exactly the situation you need logs for.
